card: A finished illustration for a children's English lesson keepsake, on true transparent background, square 1024x1024. Style: simple round storybook cartoon, very clean bold DARK BROWN outlines, large round heads, small dot eyes and tiny rounded noses, cheerful open smiles, soft flat pastel fills with subtle watercolor grain; NOT realistic faces, NOT anime or 3D. Depict TWO clearly adult familiar neighbours greeting each other at a street corner. Steven stands on the LEFT looking RIGHT at Helen: small silver-gray curls beneath a moss green flat cap, forest-green buttoned jacket over cream shirt, warm brown trousers. Helen stands on the RIGHT looking LEFT at Steven: straight black bob with short fringe, plum-purple long coat over an ivory outfit, muted blue handbag hanging from one elbow. Steven lifts one open hand in greeting; Helen responds with a gentle open hand near her chest. Their full faces, hands, elbows and handbag are wholly visible and anatomically clear. Medium closeup, faces and reciprocal greeting dominate; a pale understated street-corner fence and tiny tree behind them fades softly into transparency. Lower torsos softly fade only below all hands. Generous transparent margin around all edges, no cropped fingers. Stylized adult proportions matching a warm classroom picture-book. No text, letters, speech balloons, labels, stars, certificates or frames; no occupations, no children, no assumed romance. This is Lesson 9–10, How are you today?, friendly greeting and farewell.
talk: Use the attached keepsake illustration as the exact character and style reference. Produce a FULL BODY two-person stage cast on a transparent square 1024x1024 canvas. Steven stays on the LEFT, silver-gray curls, moss green flat cap, forest-green jacket, cream shirt, brown long trousers and brown shoes. Helen stays on the RIGHT, straight black bob with fringe, plum-purple long coat over an ivory knee-length dress, blue handbag over one elbow, flat brown shoes. Keep their distinct round faces, simple eyes, soft flat colors and thick brown outlines. They face one another, Steven looks RIGHT at Helen, Helen looks LEFT at Steven. Every hair, fingertip, elbow, handbag, shoe and both entire bodies must fit with generous transparent margin. Do not crop. No fence, tree, background, floor, text, labels, speech bubbles or extra people. About 3.5 heads tall, stylized adults rather than toddlers. Keep the same scale for both.
